subject: Coffee & Tea
title: Kaldi and the Dancing Goats
description: A quick win: understand Kaldi and the Dancing Goats.

hook.text: The most famous coffee legend begins with an Ethiopian goatherd named Kaldi—and his mysteriously energetic goats.

buildup.text: Kaldi noticed his goats dancing wildly after eating red berries from a certain bush on the highland plateau.

discovery.text: He brought the berries to a monastery. A monk threw them into fire in disgust—and the aroma of roasting coffee filled the air.

twist.text: The story first appears in print in 1671—over a thousand years after coffee was likely first used. It may be entirely invented.

climax.text: Despite its uncertain origin, the Kaldi legend is retold on coffee bags, café walls, and brand stories worldwide.

punchline.text: A goatherd, dancing goats, and an accidental roast. Coffee's founding myth endures.

quiz.question: When did the Kaldi legend first appear in print?
options: 1671 — over a thousand years after coffee was likely first used
